versions.changelog:
Initial release of Winchester Physics Bare Metal, optimized for theoretical physics research on high-end local hardware.

- Tailored for AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT CPU and RX 6600XT GPU with 48GB RAM.
- Utilizes an unsandboxed gemma4 configuration with nomi-embed-text for performance.
- Features a stable 54/46 GPU/CPU resource allocation.
- Targets theoretical physics applications (Probability-Cycle theory).
- Addresses and prevents common no_re event-loop errors for improved stability.
